operations.description: Two-sided range guard on a3: in-range path is a3 <= 0.49599999 and a3 >= -0.49599999; otherwise clamp.
In-range path scales a3 by 256.0 and truncates to a byte value v4.
Clamp low: a3 below -0.49599999 encodes to -127.
Clamp high: a3 above 0.49599999 encodes to 127.
Write the encoded byte v4 to this[a2 + 18].
Two-sided range guard on a4: in-range path is a4 <= 327.67001 and a4 >= -327.67001; otherwise clamp.
In-range path scales a4 by 100.0 and truncates to a 16-bit short value v8.
Clamp low: a4 below -327.67001 encodes to -32767.
Clamp high: a4 above 327.67001 encodes to 0x7FFF.
Write the encoded short to this[2*a2 + 22]; result carries the encoded value.
Return the encoded short value as result.
